basics.description: Deploy the Cohere-powered R&D knowledge solution with Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, Container Apps, observability, and optional Microsoft Fabric integration.

location.label: Deployment region
location.toolTip: Choose a region that supports Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Storage, and Azure Container Apps. Cohere model availability and capacity are validated for this region.

basics.name: baseName
basics.label: Application base name

validations.message: Use 3-20 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, starting with a letter and ending with a letter or number.

basics.toolTip: Use a short lowercase prefix for the managed application and generated Azure resource names.

options.text: The Microsoft.CognitiveServices model catalog and regional model-capacity APIs validate every Cohere model, version, SKU, and requested capacity before deployment.
